newsitem.title: USA: Sara Lee to sell stake in Aris Isotoner.
newsitem.headline: Sara Lee to sell stake in Aris Isotoner.

text.p: Sara Lee Corp said Thursday it reached an agreement with totes inc, in which Sara Lee will combine its Aris Isotoner division with totes inc, a company controlled by Bain Capital Inc, to create a new venture that will be known as totes Isotoner.
Aris Isotoner markets gloves, slippers and cold weather accessories. totes markets umbrellas, casual rainwear and rubber footwear.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed. Sara Lee said it will retain an ownership interest in the totes Isotoner venture.
"Although Aris Isotoner has been a part of Sara Lee Corporation since 1969, its products are no longer a core focus for the company, said John Bryan, chairman and chief executive officer of Sara Lee.
"We believe that significant synergies will be created by the combination of these two leading accessories brands," he said in a statement.

Sara Lee markets a variety of products under brand names, including Sara Lee, Ball Park, Hillshire Farm, Jimmy Dean, Aoste, Douwe Egberts, Hanes, Hanes Her Way, L'eggs, Bali, Playtex, Champion, Coach, Dim, Sanex and Kiwi.
